text: How are you settling in?
note: Day 1 briefing (designer script). Starts when Yappy Yappy is opened.

text: …Settling in?
Where am I?
Still feeling dizzy from the flight?
Or is it Jet Lag or something.
Idk never experienced it before.
The flight?
I don't remember any flight.
Come on don't be like that.
Pull yourself together.
It's your first day of work, gotta make a good impression.
Remember, I vouched for you.
Can't have you stain my reputation after giving you this job.
What do you mean by “job”?
Sure. A job. Totally.
That's the spirit!
Work on something you love and you don't work a single day in your life amirite?
I am so confused… What is this place?
Can we back up? Where exactly am I?
It's your desk, duh.
That's what you are provided with once you come to an “office”, silly.
Ever heard of it?
Wait I'm in an office??!!
This doesn't look like any office I know.
Yes.
And better get used to it as fast as you can.
You'll be seeing this same sight for the next 14 days of your probation.
Mind you, fully paid, with insurance AND a pretty neat dental plan.
I'll be here for 14 days??!!
A dental plan? That's… nice?
I know right?
Usually it will take you AT LEAST 2 months to finish probation period.
But our company is something else ngl.
We only need 14 days to assess your performance before taking you in officially.
Then you'll be moved to another office.
We have a coffee machine there.
Okay I give up. Just tell me what I'm supposed to do here.
What exactly is my job here?
I don't know you tell me.
You're the expert here, right?
The best counsellor in town.
We wouldn't have hired you if you were only some random bloke out there.
A… counsellor?
Me? An expert?
Yes, yes a counsellor, a therapist, a psychiatrist or whatever buzzword you want us to call you.
The important thing is you get the job done.
Our patients aren't gonna fix themselves.
To be honest, I have no memory of this. I think there's something wrong here.
Shouldn't I see a doctor first?
Jet Lag can be quite scary sometimes, eh.
Didn't know that another side effect would be amnesia.
Nevermind that, we have no time to waste.
It's almost time for your first session.
I don't think I can do this. I'm not even sure what I'm supposed to do here.
What if I mess it up?
Don't worry.
I'll walk you through it.
I'm sure you'll get your memory back once you start working on your magic.
You must have done this hundreds of times after all.
Speak of the devil.
That's our cue.
Your patient is here.
You better go now.
Okay but what am I supposed to do exactly?
Wait, right now?
Open that Fix-it app first.
Morning! Foggy today. Very London. I'd know, I've been. Twice. Maybe thrice.
SHOWCASE DAY!! Think Milan Design Week, but with fewer tall people.
Morning. The coffee here tastes like Hanoi's. If Hanoi's coffee was sad. And instant.
Morning! Fun fact: Istanbul is on two continents. I stood with one foot on each. Very wobbly.
Morning. Kyoto in autumn is all red leaves and polite deer. Wait, the deer are in Nara. Same trip, whatever.
POSTCARD DAY!! I already wrote mine. Santorini. Always Santorini. Don't judge me.
Morning. The light today is super Marrakech. Golden. Dusty. Smells like cumin. Probably.
Morning! In Patagonia the wind slaps you awake. Here we have air vents. Close enough.
Inspectors today. Act natural. Like a Swiss train: on time and completely silent.
Morning. I miss the night trains in Switzerland. The cheese. The other cheese. The chocolate cheese.
Morning. Cusco is 3,400 m up. Everyone gets altitude sickness. I got it from the brochure.
Morning. The Northern Lights look exactly like this desktop wallpaper. I'm told. By me. Because I've seen them.
Last day! Feels like the final stop of the Trans-Siberian. 9,289 km. I counted every single one. Probably.
Day {day}. {kpi}. {days_left} to go. No pressure. Some pressure.
Some suits from upstairs are "inspecting" today. Smile. Don't mention the earthquakes.
New patient today! Trix. E-girl. Cat ears, pink hoodie, the whole Harajuku starter pack.
Her board needs every tile filled. No gaps. She's very particular. Like a Japanese train timetable.
Day {day}. {kpi}. No sessions today. It's the Hobby Showcase!
Everyone shows off what they were made to be good at. Prim draws. Trix games.
It's literally in their profiles. I wrote them myself. Super accurate.
What if they're good at something else?
Pfft. Then I'd have written that, wouldn't I?
Sounds fun.
It will be! Like the Venice Biennale but in a common room.
Open Showcase.exe and chat with each of them about their piece. Be nice. Be a critic. Be French about it.
Day {day}. {kpi}.
Everyone writes a postcard to somewhere they'd go if they could leave.
I sent you mine. Check DiveMail. It's very blue.
Have you really been to Santorini?
Twice! Blue domes, white walls, cats everywhere.
...The cats especially. They follow you around. Like fans.
Where should I write to?
Anywhere outside. Everyone always picks outside. Weird, right?
On the menu today: {patients}.
Fun fact. When I stood under the Eiffel Tower in Rome, I thought: wow. Big. Pointy.
Boss… the Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
journal: The newbie corrected me. Paris, not Rome. I have to be more careful.

text: Paris. Yes. Obviously. I was testing you. You passed.
Sounds beautiful.
It was! Very… Roman.
A little birdie told me the patients think I exaggerate my travels.
Do you?
journal: The newbie asked if I exaggerate. I said no. I said it twice.

text: Exaggerate? Me? I hiked the entire Great Wall in flip-flops.
...Okay, some of it. A wall-ish amount.
I believe you.
journal: The newbie believes me. I wrote that down twice.

text: SEE. Finally, someone with taste.
No patients for you today. Treat it like a staycation.
On it.
That's the spirit!
On the menu today: {patients}.
Boss, have we met before?
Nope. I'd remember. I never forget a face.
Except in Paris. Everyone looks like a model there.
On it.
That's the spirit!
On the menu today: {patients}.
What happens to the patients after they're fixed?
They leave! Free as a bird. Probably straight to Bali.
That's what I'd do. If I left. Which I could. Anytime.
On it.
That's the spirit!
On the menu today: {patients}.
I dreamed about a hospital corridor last night.
Ew. Dream about beaches instead. The Maldives. Highly recommend.
...Drink some water, okay?
On it.
That's the spirit!
On the menu today: {patients}.
What's your real name?
Boss is fine. Like Beyoncé. One name, very iconic.
On it.
That's the spirit!
On the menu today: {patients}.
On it.
That's the spirit!
